pr_title: Wrap lever UUID in XML tags to prevent UUID leakage in free-text fields
pr_description: XML-tagged UUID**: Replace `Lever ID: {uuid}` with `<lever>{uuid}</lever>`. XML tags signal structural markup — models treat it as metadata rather than text to copy into synergy/conflict fields. Full UUID preserved first in block for reliable matching. Positive framing**: "refer to levers by their name" Exact-count instruction**: "Return exactly N characterizations — one per lever, no more, no fewer" OPTIMIZE_INSTRUCTIONS**: Document lessons from PRs #457-464 Previous attempts: negative prohibitions backfired (#458), hex prefixes broke haiku (#460), integer indices broke matching (#462), moving UUID to end broke positional heuristics (#464).
